title: Abra Escapes Danger Asleep, Then Wakes Panicked
premise: Abra can teleport to safety while asleep, then wakes without knowing where it landed and panics.
audiencePromise: See Abra's sleeping escape and the panic that follows when it wakes.
openLoop: How can escaping danger make Abra panic?
payoff: Abra's escape does its job: danger is avoided, but waking reveals the cost.
engagementQuestion: Would you choose safe sleep or an unknown wake-up?

voice.instructions: Quick, warm, and slightly uneasy. Stress safe, unknown, and panic. Use short pauses before each reveal. Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange fact.

scenes.headline: ESCAPES ASLEEP. WAKES PANICKED.
scenes.narration: Abra escapes danger asleep, then wakes panicked.
scenes.caption: SAFE ESCAPE. UNKNOWN DESTINATION.

scenes.headline: DANGER FINDS IT ASLEEP
scenes.narration: Abra sleeps eighteen hours a day, even while danger approaches.
scenes.caption: ABRA SLEEPS 18 HOURS

scenes.headline: SAFETY HAPPENS WITHOUT WAKING
scenes.narration: Danger triggers a sleeping teleport, sending Abra to safety.
scenes.caption: DANGER → TELEPORT → SAFETY

scenes.headline: IT DOESN'T KNOW WHERE IT IS
scenes.narration: When Abra wakes, it has no idea where it is.
scenes.caption: WHERE AM I?

scenes.headline: SAFETY ENDS IN PANIC
scenes.narration: The escape succeeds, yet waking leaves Abra panicked and unsure of its location.
scenes.caption: ESCAPE SUCCESS. PANIC FOLLOWS.

scenes.headline: WOULD YOU TAKE THAT DEAL?
scenes.narration: Would you choose safe sleep or an unknown wake-up?
scenes.caption: SAFE SLEEP OR UNKNOWN WAKE-UP?
